attempts.summary: Configured node1 as the source of truth and node2 to pull /etc/inventory/app.conf automatically every minute using RHEL 7-compatible cron, OpenSSH, and an atomic replacement script. Synchronization and persistence were proven before and after sequential node restarts; both nodes retain RHEL 7.9 and kernel 3.10.0-1160.el7.x86_64.
